_readme: Small config the agent reads/writes each run. artifactUrl is filled in after the first successful publish and must be reused (not regenerated) on every subsequent run so updates land on the same page instead of creating a new one each day.
pagesPublishScope: every run — uses GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN if set (scheduled cloud runs), else the local gh CLI
lastRunStatus: Weekly research run: 2 new evidence rows admitted (Census BTOS firm-size/sector AI-adoption breakdown enriching genai-adoption-plateau-scaling-gap; a disclosed-methodology Gartner survey of 350 executives at $1B+-revenue autonomous-AI adopters, admitted as contradicting evidence). One red-team score downgrade: ai-productivity-reallocated-not-cut 4→3, now contested (Gartner Q3 2025 survey finds workforce cuts among large-firm autonomous/agentic adopters uncorrelated with realized ROI, clearing the reliability>=3 downgrade threshold; a previously recorded no-methodology Deloitte figure citing the same ~80% headline was flagged as likely the same underlying study rather than independent corroboration). Red-teamed the 4 opportunities at evidenceScore>=4 last checked 2026-08-10; three had no contradicting evidence survive (agentic-ai-governance-outpaces-readiness, ai-compresses-engineering-team-size-junior-pipeline, genai-adoption-plateau-scaling-gap unchanged; ai-bifurcates-it-staffing-support-contracts-infra-grows enriched with a same-study companion data point, no score change). No new opportunity created — Product Management (searched 3rd consecutive run), Data Engineering, and QA/Test Engineering again yielded only commentary/framework pieces or out-of-window sources, nothing cleared the reliability>=3 founding bar. Both the Claude Artifact and the GitHub Pages mirror published successfully (publish_pages.py and --verify both exited 0).
pagesTokenPermissions: fine-grained PAT, repository access limited to sdm1130/ai-it-research-tracker, Contents: Read and write (Metadata: Read-only is added automatically). Nothing else required: main has no branch protection or rulesets, and Pages is build_type=legacy on main:/ so it rebuilds on push.

pagesPublishExitCodes.3: no credentials — skip and report mirror stale
pagesPublishExitCodes.1: real failure e.g. expired token — report loudly
